llm_response.reason: The website claims to sell Chiara Ferragni brand products but uses an unrelated domain (lexiegavin.shop), indicating brand spoofing (characteristic #16). The contact and privacy policy pages both return 404 errors, failing to provide appropriate business contacts or clear privacy information (characteristics #6 and #7). SSL certificate issues indicate poor security (possible characteristic #10). The site uses common scam lures such as 'secure 100% shopping', 'free delivery', and deals, targeting psychological weaknesses (characteristics #1 and #3). There is no indication of a legitimate or verifiable company backing the site (characteristic #4). These combined factors strongly indicate a fake online shopping scam.
